pieces.Text: Three times per day, a sea hag can cast her dire gaze upon any single creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC

Will save or be staggered as strange nebulous distress and a gnawing sense of impending doom plagues the victim. If a sea hag uses her evil eye on someone already afflicted by this curse, the victim must make a DC
Fortitude save or be overwhelmed with fright and collapse into a comatose state for 3 days. Each day that passes, the comatose victim must make a DC
Fortitude save or perish. The evil eye is a mind-affecting fear effect.
